integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained modulo standard Bohr recurrence, the self-adjoint spectral theorem and Kaplansky density; the optional finite checker tests only exact scalar identities, not infinite-dimensional implications. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact assertions concern the Lebesgue spectral multiplication generator on L2(R), not arbitrary spectral types. Strong-operator measurable recovery does not imply operator-norm stability. No strong convergence rate is proved.
title: Sharp norm-versus-von-Neumann recovery for sampled unitary resolvents
